card.name: US partisan politics commentary, Republican presidents
card.fires_on: Words inside American political commentary about Republican figures and policies, such as Bush, Reagan-era tax cuts and Tea Party senators. It fires on the word right after a political name or claim, such as 'George', 'of' or 'is'.

modes.label: Bush and Republican names
modes.description: First or last names of Republican politicians in election and presidency discussion.

modes.label: Words in partisan criticism
modes.description: Ordinary linking words inside opinionated passages attacking Republican policy.
modes.example: making possible the rise<< of>> the one-sided radio and TV we see

card.writes: Suppresses 'lib' and 'progressive' tokens, so it steers away from liberal-labelled continuations.
card.plain: It lights up in opinion writing about US Republican politicians and their policies.
